facts.fact: ANICNS, under the Ministry of Public Health, launched a call for expressions of interest (AMI N° ANICNS/AMI/004/CGMP/2026, deadline 2026-07-12) to set up a national health data centre by public-private partnership, to centralise national health data and ensure interoperability between existing systems using HL7/FHIR.

systems.owner: ANICNS (Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévoyance Sociale)

note: as_of is the published date, the document giving no separate date for the launch; the centre is at procurement stage and no exchange in service is stated.
States a homologation requirement (FHIR, DICOM, API REST conformity, INS-based patient identity) for hospital information systems, not an exchange under way or in service.
Names DHIS2 for outbreak data collection and sharing, with no exchange between health systems stated.
Anonymised Vodacom phone records analysed by Flowminder for WHO; telecom data, not an exchange between health information systems.
A dashboard inside the one national DHIS2; no exchange between health systems stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health with HISP DRC and COUSP

note: Ebola Tracker configuration within DHIS2 and a continental DHIS2 toolkit; no exchange between separate DRC health systems stated.
US PEPFAR/donor funding for interoperable health information systems stated only as an aim; no exchange contracted, piloted or in service for the country.
